inputs: 02_analytics/torque_speed_envelope.py (300 kW constants, WRSM per-unit model; read-only)
02_analytics/fair_baselines.py (stator design code, gear rule, realistic loss set; read-only)
board/prior_work.md P1 (rectifier 99 % / 87 %), board/decisions.md D02, D03, D05

inverter.N_dependence: coil-frame model independent of N (V_leg = 1200/N, c = 48/(3N) coils in series per leg, N_c = 3); N enters through k_d(p) and module balance of each pole mode (see winding)

policies.If_weakening: WRSM-style: field currents free within the rotor-copper limit (group A unipolar, group B bipolar) + free I_d <= 0
policies.fixed_field: field at the maximum of each mode, flux weakening by I_d only (PMSM-style)
policies.If_weakening_bipolarA: sensitivity: group-A coil may also buck its PM (demagnetisation risk not checked)

notes: Efficiency is machine only (no inverter, no gearbox); includes field copper and exciter (rectifier) loss.
Rotor iron, pole-face and PM eddy losses are not included (as for the T03b IMs, whose rotor iron loss is also excluded).
Friction/windage = T03 law (T03d replaces it in T07).

winding.spb_generalises_conto: Conto2022hybrid feeds each phase from two half-power inverters, coils under odd/even pole pairs; reversing inverter 2 (and swapping B/C) gives 4 poles. In SPB terms that is N = 2 with a fixed 0/180 deg group shift. SPB with N modules sets each leg phase freely (alpha_k = p 2 pi k/Q), so any p not divisible by 3 is available, the low-pole winding factor rises (T03 stator: 0.793 SPB-16 vs Conto feed value in mappings), and both harmonics can be carried at once during the rotor transition.

2000rpm.note: Lower bound: all current and voltage in the better rotor-field harmonic (p=4 component (A+B)/2 or p=2 component (A-B)/2); the EMF of the unused harmonic is subtracted from the voltage budget. The SPB can carry both harmonics at once (any p not divisible by 3), which can only raise the floor.
